recent.text: لامپ زرد آشپزخانه، بیسِ زیرش را به رقص می‌کشاند تا قهوه‌ساز بیدار شود.
recent.author: حافظ

recent.text: A lone road stretches thin, its gravel whispering under hesitant footsteps, as distant thunder hints at a fragile promise that could dissolve with the next gust.
recent.author: Edgar Allan Poe

recent.text: A warm hand slips from a child's palm, the lingering heat fading like a fleeting summer breath.
recent.author: William Shakespeare

recent.text: I leave a quiet hallway waiting for the echo of a footstep that never arrives.
recent.author: Emily Dickinson

recent.text: A shiver runs across the cold metal panel, each tremor tracing the grain like a fleeting hour that holds a universe of unspoken stories.
recent.author: William Blake

recent.text: A neon billboard flickers over a cracked cobblestone, promising tomorrow while the puddle reflects yesterday's rain.
recent.author: Edgar Allan Poe

recent.text: Shift the amber streetlight’s glow as it flickers, tracing the edge of a promise that slips farther into night.
recent.author: William Shakespeare

recent.text: A sapling unfurls its first leaves, catching morning light as the world whispers the promise of becoming.
recent.author: Emily Dickinson

recent.text: دست تو بر دستهٔ قهوه‌ساز سرد می‌ماند، گویی صبرِ یک صبحِ بی‌پایان را می‌کشد.
recent.author: مولانا

recent.text: A coffee cart rolls down the avenue, its wheels humming a familiar cadence that nudges strangers into spontaneous smiles, as the city’s pulse syncs with an unseen promise of friendship.
recent.author: William Blake

recent.text: Trace the trembling line of distant hills as the music lifts a fragile promise across the open plain.
recent.author: Edgar Allan Poe

recent.text: A worn wooden spoon, its handle suddenly humming with the faint heat of a sunrise breath, feels like a quiet promise resting in the palm.
recent.author: Emily Dickinson

recent.text: I press the crumpled paper of our unfinished letters into the cool glass, its faint imprint lingering like a quiet promise that the world will remember us, even when the ink fades.
recent.author: William Shakespeare

recent.text: A sudden teal flash ripples across the hallway, like a fleeting petal catching sunrise, nudging the pulse of the moment forward.
recent.author: William Blake

recent.text: A lone hill’s shadow drifts a foot farther over the meadow as the morning light thins, marking the quiet shift from yesterday’s glow to today’s hush.
recent.author: Edgar Allan Poe

recent.text: Grip the cold metal railing as the surge of distorted chords presses against your ribs, like a storm‑charged breath that steadies the pulse.
recent.author: Emily Dickinson

recent.text: A rusted garden trowel sprouts tiny leaves, each blade whispering that even the most stubborn tools can nurture new soil.
recent.author: Andrej Karpathy

recent.text: A tiny desk lamp flickers in a vast, silent hall, reminding that even the smallest glow persists when the world stretches beyond.
recent.author: Daniel Kaluuya

recent.text: On the rain‑slick boulevard, the empty bench keeps your forgotten footsteps, as if the city waits for the one who never returns.
recent.author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson

recent.text: A burst of amber light slashes across the dance floor, each step a pulse that propels the night forward like a daring heartbeat.
recent.author: William Ernest Henley

recent.text: A light breeze tingles the skin, nudging the pulse to sync with the playful riff, as if each note invites the world to lean into the moment’s quiet daring.
recent.author: Daniel Kwan & Daniel Scheinert

recent.text: A cracked vinyl sleeve shivers under neon glare, spilling a flash of reckless camaraderie that fuels the engine’s roar and leaves the night humming with unexpected gratitude.
recent.author: Ann Patchett

recent.text: Cross the wind‑scarred ridge, each step echoing the quiet fork where yesterday’s promise splits from tomorrow’s unknown.
recent.author: Robert Frost

recent.text: A cracked sidewalk tile, suddenly humming with a stray saxophone’s breath, turns the rush of the boulevard into a brief invitation to chase the next note.
recent.author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson

recent.text: A seedling pushes through cracked concrete, listening to a distant call that urges it to rise beyond the noise.
recent.author: William Butler Yeats

recent.text: دست‌ام بر لبهٔ شیشه سرد می‌لغزد؛ نفس‌نفس‌پایین می‌کشد و لحظهٔ گرمای اولیهٔ صبح، همانند نوای خفیف، به تدریج جای خود را به سوزش آفتاب می‌دهد.
recent.author: فردوسی

recent.text: A teacup trembles on the windowsill as the night wind hums through the kitchen fan, holding a silent duel between heat and chill.
recent.author: Barbara Kingsolver

recent.text: A thin sheet of glass shivers under the riff's electric surge, sending a cool tremor across the skin like sunrise on steel.
recent.author: Amanda Gorman

recent.text: A narrow corridor yawns, its far wall holding a flicker that refuses to fade, urging the traveler onward.
recent.author: Michelle Yeoh

recent.text: یک سنگ خشن در دل صحرا، ناگهان با پرتو نور صبح از افق دور، تبدیل به بوم‌نقشی از ضربه‌های ریتمیک می‌شود.
recent.author: مصطفی ملکیان

recent.text: بذرهای شبنم بر شاخ‌های بهار می‌چرخند، یاد تو را که در دل خاک نهفته است، به آرامی می‌کشاند.
recent.author: عطار

recent.text: A sunrise amber glint catches the edge of a cracked window, where the night’s lingering hush slips into a soft, steady pulse.
recent.author: Nelson Mandela

recent.text: باران‌نقطه‌های ریز بر آسفالت خیس، چراغ‌های کم‌سو راه را به رقصی نقره‌ای می‌کشاند؛ هر قدم به سمت نور، زخم‌های دیروز را به سکوی امید می‌سازد.
recent.author: گروس عبدالملکیان

recent.text: دست‌های ساکت بر لبهٔ شیشه سرد می‌لغزند، گرمای نفس‌پایین در دل شب می‌چرخد و وزن لحظه را به‌هم می‌ریزد.
recent.author: داریوش مهرجویی

recent.text: Traverse the sun‑warmed plateau, letting each footfall untie the knots of yesterday’s expectations.
recent.author: Alain de Botton

recent.text: A wilted leaf clings to a blooming branch, reminding us that moving forward can feel like holding onto the past.
recent.author: Ryan Gosling

recent.text: A solitary desk lamp, its filament replaced by a tiny orbiting planet, casts a vast, quiet glow that reminds the room how small certainty feels against endless curiosity.
recent.author: Adam Grant

recent.text: A lone tram rattles past a cracked storefront, its rhythm echoing the pulse of midnight sidewalks, where every step feels like a quiet promise of sunrise.
recent.author: Nick Cave

recent.text: A gentle pulse underfoot spreads across the sun‑baked plateau, as distant ridges glimmer with a quiet promise of unseen wonder.
recent.author: Karl Ove Knausgård

recent.text: A polished teacup holds a whisper of storm, its fragile curve echoing a calm that feels louder than any song.
recent.author: Alejandro G. Iñárritu

recent.text: A crumpled page slides over a glass table, each crease whispering a memory that refuses to settle.
recent.author: Annie Ernaux

recent.text: A breath cools the night‑air, then a faint warmth lingers as the streetlights flicker, reminding the skin that even fleeting kindness can stretch a moment longer.
recent.author: Rutger Bregman

recent.text: A neon ripple slides across the pavement, each pulse echoing a heartbeat that remembers a smile now distant, turning the street into a fleeting runway of lingering warmth.
recent.author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie

recent.text: A cool draft brushes the back of your neck, echoing the hollow of an empty hallway where each silent step reminds you that distant strangers share the same breath of possibility.
recent.author: Bernie Sanders

recent.text: A glass bottle, its surface etched with tiny constellations, catches the room’s ordinary light and turns it into a quiet map of forgotten wishes.
recent.author: Greta Gerwig

recent.text: A lone pine's needle, once bright green, now tinged amber, catches the late afternoon wind, marking the hill's quiet shift from day to dusk.
recent.author: Gabor Maté

recent.text: A sunrise glints off a rusted car hood, while the dashboard clock stubbornly reads midnight, reminding the road that hope and habit travel side by side.
recent.author: Denzel Washington

recent.text: Burst through cracked soil, new shoots thrust upward, each ring of the growing stem echoing the relentless pull of a chain that binds yet fuels relentless ascent.
recent.author: Jane Goodall

recent.text: If you stood by the wide window, you'd see the room stretch like a quiet runway, each empty chair a waypoint waiting for the footsteps you never took.
recent.author: Carlo Rovelli

recent.text: A thin glass pane gathers a fleeting line of dew, marking night’s breath fading into dawn’s sigh, as if the surface heeds an inner urge to awaken.
recent.author: Patti Smith

recent.text: A coffee mug catches a sudden amber gleam, as if sunrise slipped through its handle.
recent.author: Matt Haig

recent.text: Bridge distant horizons with a pulse that stitches strangers together across the night‑lit dunes.
recent.author: Kazuo Ishiguro

recent.text: A cool hand rests on a warm throat, the weight of silence breathing into a rhythm that feels both feather and stone.
recent.author: Emily Dickinson

recent.text: A single cherry seed cracks the soil of a balcony garden, nudging a vine to unfurl as the city hum fades into the promise of spring.
recent.author: Yvon Chouinard

recent.text: You, like a torn page that keeps rewinding to the same line, seem to linger in the glass of my thoughts.
recent.author: Ethan Hawke

recent.text: A chipped teacup suddenly hums with the distant echo of a forgotten laugh, reminding the room that partings are only pauses.
recent.author: Benedict Cumberbatch

recent.text: A fingertip feels the coffee mug’s surface cool then warm as the sunrise slides across the kitchen, each second a gentle rise of heat that marks the day’s quiet turning.
recent.author: Jiro Taniguchi

recent.text: Neon amber flickers across the highway, each pulse a fleeting promise that the night will still answer tomorrow's call.
recent.author: Margaret Atwood

1273.caption: «ای که در افق ناپدید شدی، سنگ‌های خسته مسیر به سکوت تو گوش می‌دهند، همان‌گونه که بادهای دور، نغمه‌ای از دل‌تنهایی می‌فرستند.»
1273.text: ای که در افق ناپدید شدی، سنگ‌های خسته مسیر به سکوت تو گوش می‌دهند، همان‌گونه که بادهای دور، نغمه‌ای از دل‌تنهایی می‌فرستند.
1273.author: سعدی

1274.caption: «لرزش نازک شیشه زیر انگشتان، همچون نغمه‌ای که از دل پارچه‌ای پاره می‌گذرد، یادآور جدایی بی‌پایان است.»
1274.text: لرزش نازک شیشه زیر انگشتان، همچون نغمه‌ای که از دل پارچه‌ای پاره می‌گذرد، یادآور جدایی بی‌پایان است.
1274.author: حافظ

1275.caption: «دوید به افق خسته‌ام، گام‌هایم خاک را می‌پوشانند تا نغمهٔ بی‌گریه‌ات را به باد بسپارند.»
1275.text: دوید به افق خسته‌ام، گام‌هایم خاک را می‌پوشانند تا نغمهٔ بی‌گریه‌ات را به باد بسپارند.
1275.author: حافظ

1276.caption: «ساعت دیوار خالی، نیمی از نور صبح به آرامی به لبهٔ پنجره می‌چرخد، گویی تصمیمِ گریه کردن در دل سکوت می‌لغزد.»
1276.text: ساعت دیوار خالی، نیمی از نور صبح به آرامی به لبهٔ پنجره می‌چرخد، گویی تصمیمِ گریه کردن در دل سکوت می‌لغزد.
1276.author: سعدی

1277.caption: «یک شاخه‌ی خشک در دست من، ناگهان سبزه‌های نقره‌ای می‌رویند، گویی بهاری درون آن می‌جوشد.»
1277.text: یک شاخه‌ی خشک در دست من، ناگهان سبزه‌های نقره‌ای می‌رویند، گویی بهاری درون آن می‌جوشد.
1277.author: سعدی

1285.caption: "You, who linger like the first amber glow on the lake, keep the world from slipping into dusk."
1285.text: You, who linger like the first amber glow on the lake, keep the world from slipping into dusk.
1285.author: William Shakespeare

1287.caption: "A lone kettle whistles a stray chorus, the steam spelling a fleeting map that dissolves as the door clicks shut."
1287.text: A lone kettle whistles a stray chorus, the steam spelling a fleeting map that dissolves as the door clicks shut.
1287.author: Edgar Allan Poe

1474.caption: «صفحه‌های نازک دفتر، همچون موجی که بر لبه‌های شیشه می‌لغزند، هویت خسته‌ام را به رقص می‌کشند.»
1474.text: صفحه‌های نازک دفتر، همچون موجی که بر لبه‌های شیشه می‌لغزند، هویت خسته‌ام را به رقص می‌کشند.
1474.author: مولانا

1475.caption: «دست‌های او که از گرما به آرامی سرد می‌شوند، نفس کوتاهی را در همان لحظهٔ خنک‌تری می‌کشند.»
1475.text: دست‌های او که از گرما به آرامی سرد می‌شوند، نفس کوتاهی را در همان لحظهٔ خنک‌تری می‌کشند.
1475.author: سعدی
